verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a code-review bot, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows Bugbot only as a Cursor-hosted service. Its support for GitHub Enterprise Server, GitLab Self-Hosted and Bitbucket Data Center means it can connect to self-hosted source-control systems, not that Bugbot itself can be self-hosted. Nothing in the pack documents a deployable or on-premises version of Bugbot.
